scope: Finite static compatibility review of the prepared SAME6 adapter and seven genuine-producer extension tests. This is not a source, behavioral, runtime, resource-fit, or full-roster verdict.
static_findings: The runner loads only the exact four new module names from a future pinned binding. Legacy role dictionary keys are harness roles, not imports of an earlier owner.

The tests obtain actual source-issued owners, contexts, call references, raw slots, diagnostic guards and generated artifacts. They do not accept a decoded ready flag or mint producer identity from literal data.

NULL and opaque malformed scalar controls assert original object identity and absence of guessed close. Independent error-value and definition delivery controls assert the observed first slot while leaving the other slot UNOBSERVED.

The packing-failure test intercepts the actual codec pack_row_tuple_into function and preserves the original MemoryError. It checks canonical known/hash/capture totals, once-only original closes, missing receipt/seal, and refusal of candidate bytes.

The diagnostic test exercises the actual source guard for 16384 successful outer operations with nested sharing, then checks original and formatter exception identity, committed versus borrowed counters, and immutable issued diagnostic metadata.

The generated-artifact test delegates the actual iter_checked_records function, verifies actual artifact byte-object identity, exhausts every pass and independently checks fixed-row counts, edge count and complete query/path/module-name pools. It also checks immutable distinct candidate and terminal objects, post-final refusal and foreign-owner refusal without dispatch.

The small stream fake derives each requested read length from its own remaining-byte metadata and checks source CallRef arguments against it. It writes a periodic stream through actual source-owned buffer methods; the reference digest uses bounded 64KiB blocks without retaining the whole bulk body.

The seven extension methods plus six indexed methods are planned controls, not executed results. The prepared counts of 24 owner worlds and 30 small-stream original calls are authored expectations only.

deadline_interpretation.actual_extension_checks: Extension entry and bounded stress-loop guards, existing projector callbacks and the common post-suite late veto.
deadline_interpretation.unused_facade: DeadlineCodecFacade is defined but unused by EXTENSIONS_FIRST. Its copied report caption is not evidence of measured codec forwarding in this phase; forwarding counters remain absent/null.
deadline_interpretation.callback_exception_identity: No extension runner finally-deadline check replaces an original source or callback exception.
